_comment: Edit this file to change when you are bookable. Times are local to the timezone below, in 24h HH:MM. Use an empty list for a day off.
_slotRule: Slots are slotMinutes long, but only show inside an unbroken free run of at least minBlockMinutes. So with 30/60: a lone free half hour is not offered, a free hour offers two slots, 90 minutes offers three.
_calendarId: Leave empty. Only used as a fallback if no GOOGLE_ICS_URL secret is set, and it requires making the calendar public - which exposes event titles to anyone. The secret keeps the calendar private and always wins.
